title: Inex One Estimates Expert Network Industry Reached ~$3 Billion in 2025
summary: In its market overview updated in February 2026, Inex One estimated the expert network industry reached approximately $3 billion in 2025, growing 12% annually over 2023–25. The report says GLG and AlphaSights are tied as the largest players globally, with GLG's share having decreased from 51% to 24% within a decade. Consulting remains the largest client segment at almost half of total industry spend, while capital-markets firms account for 42% of spend.
whyItMatters: Inex One's bottom-up estimate is materially lower than the $4B+ figures published by generic market-research vendors, and its finding that AlphaSights has drawn level with GLG marks a changing of the guard at the top of the industry.
